g.text: A7 | Three accepted low-load equilibria on the actual periodic material layer
Positions are drawn at deformation ×1; color shows the actual axial displacement. All 3D states and native forces are saved at full precision.
Only one actual Y layer is displayed for readability; equilibrium and energy audits use all 16,000 nodes and all alive bonds.
